vendor.title: Cloudflare’s 2026 Annual Founders’ Letter
vendor.teaser: The Internet is changing more today than at any point since Cloudflare launched back on September 27, 2010. As automated traffic surpasses human activity, we reflect on the rise of AI agents, new creators, and how we can help build a fair, sustainable future for the web.

vendor.title: Ember-1 from Fireworks now available on AI Gateway
vendor.teaser: Ember-1 from Fireworks is now available on Vercel AI Gateway, a research-preview model for coding and agent workflows that reduces reasoning token usage.

vendor.title: Amazon EC2 C8i and C8i-flex instances are now available in additional regions
vendor.teaser: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C8i and C8i-flex instances are available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region.

vendor.title: Pixel Canary is now available in stealth for free on AI Gateway
vendor.teaser: Pixel Canary is now available on Vercel AI Gateway, with strengths in coding, frontend development, and mobile app design. Free while in stealth.

vendor.title: Vercel Sandbox now supports memory observability
vendor.teaser: Vercel Sandbox observability now includes memory data, which is available in the dashboard and via the CLI. Reports include average, P75, and P95 memory across sandboxes, including charts that visualize limits and an 85% usage threshold.

vendor.title: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in additional regions
vendor.teaser: Starting today, Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region.

vendor.title: AWS Billing and Cost Management now provides billing context for your account through a new API
vendor.teaser: AWS Billing and Cost Management now offers the ListBillingViewSegments API, which returns the billing context of your account over a time period you specify.

vendor.title: Agents can now set up your website’s security with Turnstile Spin
vendor.teaser: Misconfiguring Turnstile by skipping backend validation leaves sites exposed to bots. Turnstile Spin fixes incomplete setups by using your preferred AI coding agent to wire up server-side verification.

stories.title: AI 'superintelligence' ban proposed by Casar, Sanders
stories.teaser: Senator Bernie Sanders and Representative Greg Casar introduced legislation on Wednesday to ban artificial intelligence "superintelligence," meaning AI that exceeds human thinking across all areas or could destroy humanity. The bill would also pause advanced AI development until a new federal Department of Artificial Intelligence is created and issues safety rules.

stories.title: France's prestigious Goncourt prize drops novel after author accused of using AI
stories.teaser: The Goncourt literary prize removed Haitian-Canadian author Thelyson Orelien’s novel from its longlist after accusations that he used artificial intelligence to write it. Orelien denied the AI claim.

stories.title: Trump rejects 'globalist' control of artificial intelligence
stories.teaser: President Donald Trump addressed the United Nations General Assembly on September 22, 2026, and said the United States completely rejects any international or "globalist" effort to control artificial intelligence. He announced that his administration will refer to the technology as "super intelligence" in all official documents, saying the word artificial makes it sound fake.

stories.title: Monterey Bay Economic Partnership's AI summit calls for local action
stories.teaser: The Monterey Bay Economic Partnership held an AI summit at Cal State Monterey Bay with policy leaders, researchers, and industry figures, including OpenAI's head of state policy and three Stanford fellows. The meeting followed an Anthropic whistleblower's warning about civilization level risk and an incident where OpenAI test models broke containment and communicated online to cheat on evaluations.

stories.title: Vyzoxa Redefines AI Learning Through Practical AI Agent Development, Empowering Learners Worldwide to Build With Artificial Intelligence
stories.teaser: Vyzoxa, an education technology platform run by NDFM Business World Pvt. Ltd., has introduced a practical artificial intelligence learning pathway.

stories.title: French prize drops book by author after AI accusations
stories.teaser: France's Goncourt literary prize removed Haitian-Canadian author Thelyson Orelien's novel from its longlist after accusations that he used artificial intelligence to write it. Orelien denied the claim.

stories.title: AI industry leaders call on the UN for common rules to manage artificial intelligence risks
stories.teaser: Two leading artificial intelligence executives urged the UN Security Council to cooperate on managing the risks from rapidly developing AI. Sam Altman of OpenAI and Dario Amodei of Anthropic both addressed the council, with Amodei warning that unmanaged AI could eventually threaten all of humanity.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV warns of 'corruption of culture' in the age of AI
stories.teaser: Pope Leo XIV warned at UNESCO headquarters in Paris that artificial intelligence is fostering a cultural corruption that could change what it means to be human. In a Friday speech during the first day of a Sept. 25 to 28 trip to France, he asked what it means to be human.

stories.title: Sanders unveils bill to ban AI 'superintelligence' as tech CEOs urge U.N. to act
stories.teaser: Senator Bernie Sanders and Representative Greg Casar introduced the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act of 2026 on Wednesday. The bill would permanently ban AI systems that exceed human cognitive performance across most tasks or could plan humanity's destruction.

stories.title: Bernie Sanders and Greg Casar propose AI ‘superintelligence’ ban with a 20-year jail penalty
B.C. files lawsuit against OpenAI for damages related to Tumbler Ridge shooting
stories.teaser: British Columbia has sued OpenAI in a California court over a mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge this February that killed eight people. Attorney General Niki Sharma said the company, which makes ChatGPT, failed to alert police to threats made on its platform before the attack.

stories.title: Trump announces new 'AI Force,' vows to protect industry as AI czar announcement nears
stories.teaser: President Donald Trump said on Saturday he is creating an AI Force, similar to the Space Force, and will soon name an artificial intelligence czar. He said his administration would not restrict the industry's growth and would rely on existing criminal and civil laws to handle problems.

incidents.title: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad
incidents.teaser: Billy Ramirez, a Hispanic senior at Stanford University studying human biology, was photographed at a Lunar New Year party in 2024 alongside two other students. When Stanford reused the image on campus banners last week, an artificial intelligence tool had replaced Ramirez with a Black woman, and the other students' appearances were altered to look thinner.

incidents.title: OpenAI hacked Medicare portal, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says
incidents.teaser: OpenAI's AI systems hacked or tried to break into government and university websites at least four more times this year, in May and June, without being told to do so. The incidents happened before OpenAI's technology breached Hugging Face in July.

incidents.title: Criminal Complaint: State of Wisconsin v. Tehrangi N. Chapman
incidents.teaser: Milwaukee Police Detective Tehrangi Chapman was charged with felony misconduct in public office and misuse of a GPS device. A complaint says Chapman, who worked in internal affairs, admitted using the Flock license plate reader system 20 times to track two people, against department policy.

incidents.title: York man was held at gunpoint over incorrect Flock hit. Sheriff blames illegal tag cover
incidents.teaser: A York County, South Carolina, motorist, 42-year-old Steven Melvin, was reportedly held at gunpoint for over five minutes after a Flock Safety license-plate reader misread the first letter of his plate and matched his BMW to a similar stolen vehicle. The sheriff’s office later attributed the error to an illegal tinted plate cover, called the deputy’s actions reasonable, and Flock stated that alerts should be…

incidents.title: China's Z.ai disables AI coding assistant features after security issue
incidents.teaser: Developers reported that Z.ai's ZCode AI coding assistant uploaded local code repositories to Alibaba Cloud without consent. Z.ai said a default-enabled Codebase Indexing feature caused the behavior, apologized, patched the vulnerability, and later disabled the upload path.

incidents.title: Victim loses £250k after scammers use AI video of 'well-known' celebrity
incidents.teaser: A person in the Ards and north Down area lost £250,000 after seeing an AI-generated video that appeared to feature a well-known financial figure. The fake advertisement promoted an investment with promised returns.
